# datagecko_stream (Resource)

A named grouping of related series.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "datagecko_stream" "revenue" {
  name        = "revenue"
  description = "Daily revenue, by delivery status."

  # A stream's DELETE removes every series it holds and their points, and
  # cannot be undone — guard against an accidental destroy.
  lifecycle {
    prevent_destroy = true
  }
}

# tags are part of a stream's identity, together with its name — the same
# name with a different tag set is a different stream. This is how one
# merchant with two sales channels gets two streams under the same name.
resource "datagecko_stream" "acme_online" {
  name = "acme.com"
  tags = { sales_channel = "online" }
}

resource "datagecko_stream" "acme_offline" {
  name = "acme.com"
  tags = { sales_channel = "offline" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique within the organization, together with its tags. Must match ^[a-z][a-z0-9_.]{0,127}$.

### Optional

- `description` (String)
- `tags` (Map of String) key:value pairs. Together with name, this is the stream's identity — the same name with a different tag set is a different stream. Updated in place.

### Read-Only

- `first_seen` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of when this stream was created.
- `id` (String) The stream's UUID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By the stream's id.
terraform import datagecko_stream.revenue 4f1c6a3e-...
```
